sections.label: AVA functions transfer to NParks
sections.summary: AVA's non-food plant and animal functions move to NParks, which becomes lead agency for animal, wildlife and plant health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To enhance our approach for animal welfare and management, and plant health control, AVA's non-food plant and animal-related functions will be transferred to NParks to reap synergies with NParks' current work in wildlife conservation and horticultural science.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will become the lead agency for animal and wildlife management, as well as animal and plant health.

sections.label: New Animal and Veterinary Service
sections.summary: A new Animal and Veterinary Service will be formed under NParks as the main touchpoint for animal-related issues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: A new Animal and Veterinary Service (AVS) will be formed under NParks, as the main touchpoint for animal-related issues, whether they occur in parks, nature reserves or other parts of our city.

sections.label: Transfer effective 1 April 2019
sections.summary: The transfer takes effect on 1 April 2019, with AVA and NParks working to ensure a seamless transition for stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The transfer of AVA’s non-food plant and animal-related functions will take effect on 1 April 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA and NParks have been working together to ensure that the transition is as seamless as possible for all relevant stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to engage and work with all stakeholders to develop holistic and science-based strategies and more effective responses to animal health, welfare and management, as well as plant health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: I believe that this transfer of functions will leverage NParks’ strengths to amplify the effectiveness of AVA’s approach on animal issues thus far.

sections.label: Woman bitten by python
sections.summary: One woman was bitten by a python outside her house on the second storey of an HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One woman was even bitten by a python outside her house on the second storey of a Housing and Development Board (HDB) flat.

sections.label: Police handling snakes, expert training urged
sections.summary: The speaker finds it perplexing that Police handle snakes and urges AVS to train experts to handle wildlife and help residents.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I have always found it perplexing that the Police are called in to handle snakes.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I urge the AVS to train a group of experts who can handle wildlife and attend to residents who need help.

sections.label: Rats and cat feeder food
sections.summary: Rats appeared, traced to food left by cat feeders, and despite NEA, AVA and Town Council efforts the problem remains unsolved.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: True enough, I can see many rats dancing about, running about and I activated the National Environment Agency (NEA), AVA and the Town Council.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We found that the root cause actually is the food left behind by cat feeders, several cat feeders, not just one, and when they walked away, the rats come and eat, the big cockroaches come and eat and I asked NEA to act, they said cannot, there was an agreement by AVA and Cat Society to leave food there for two hours.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Town Council and NEA have been working very hard.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: They have been treating the burrows, sealing the burrows, catching the rats at least twice a week but we do not seem to be able to solve the problem.

sections.label: Nature, tourism and animal conflicts
sections.summary: Nature benefits tourism, eco-balance and mental health, but animals and people may conflict, so people must be educated not to panic.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Nature can bring about positive effects to tourism, eco-balance and our mental health.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But there are potential conflicts between animals and people in two areas.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We must educate our people not to panic when they see animals.

sections.label: Illegal fishing and AVA functions
sections.summary: The Bill seeks to transfer certain AVA functions to NParks to improve coordination on animal matters, while residents' safety and hygiene are considered.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In Singapore, we often see people fishing illegally.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: While it is good to take care of wildlife, we should also think more of our residents’ safety and the hygiene of their living environment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Among other things, this Bill seeks to transfer certain functions currently undertaken by AVA to NParks, which would improve the coordination and implementation of matters relating to animals.

sections.label: NParks role and cat removal
sections.summary: NParks' role covers animal welfare, safety and health and public health threats; the speaker proposes broadening it to remove animals causing severe disamenities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: NParks’ new role covers protecting the welfare, safety and health of animals, as well as preventing and managing threats to public health and safety from animals or plants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: For the case I have highlighted, on the one occasion that HDB and AVA were able to enter the flat, AVA was unable to remove the cats because although the cats were staying in an unhygienic condition, they were generally in good health and the current rules only allow the removal of the animals if they are found to be mistreated or in poor health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: As such, I would like to propose broadening NPark’s responsibility to include removing animals where they cause severe public disamenities which would presumably include stench suffered by neighbours.

sections.label: AVA and NParks merger welcomed
sections.summary: A speaker who has spoken up for animals for over 20 years says the AVA and NParks merger is good news for animal protection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But, Sir, I have spent more than half of my life, over 20 years, speaking up for animals and giving them a voice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I have to say that this merger of AVA and NParks is good news for the animal protection community.

sections.label: Combining plant and animal functions
sections.summary: Because mobile animals complicate matters across multiple agencies, combining all non-food plant and animal-related functions is welcomed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: As these animals are quite mobile, things can get quite complicated with multiple agencies involved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Thus, the move to combine all non-food plant and animal-related functions is very much a welcomed one.

sections.label: Scientific studies on culling measures
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Senior Parliamentary Secretary to confirm whether any scientific studies show that current culling measures work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can the Senior Parliamentary Secretary also confirm whether there are any scientific studies that show that our current culling measures work?

sections.label: Research on culling increasing population
sections.summary: Scientific research shows culling fails to reduce populations and actually leads to an increase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In fact, there is scientific research that shows the contrary, that is, that culling not only fails to reduce the population, it actually leads to an increase.

sections.label: Pigeon culling in city
sections.summary: Over 24 years of intensive culling, 100,000 pigeons were killed, and the population rose from 20,000 to 30,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Over a period of 24 years of intensive culling, they killed 100,000 pigeons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Instead of having 20,000 pigeons, they now have 30,000 pigeons.

sections.label: Pigeon population decrease
sections.summary: Within four and a half years, the city's pigeon population decreased to 10,000 birds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Within four and a half years, the city’s pigeon population decreased to 10,000 birds.

sections.label: Monkey culling ineffective
sections.summary: Culling of monkeys is similarly ineffective as it is usually the young ones who get trapped.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The culling of monkeys is similarly ineffective as it is usually the young ones who get trapped.

sections.label: Assurances and NParks consolidation
sections.summary: Speaker hopes the public is assured this is not a joke and asks the Senior Parliamentary Secretary for assurances, expecting greater synergy after consolidating non-food-related plant and animal functions to NParks under the Ministry of National Development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I hope that the public is now assured that this is not a joke and perhaps that it is really happening, and maybe the Senior Parliamentary Secretary can also provide some assurances on that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: We can expect greater synergy and efficiency after the consolidation of all non-food-related plant and animal functions to NParks under the Ministry of National Development.

sections.label: NParks managing wild bird populations
sections.summary: Questions ask if NParks plans to manage wild bird populations in estates, tackle seasonal big populations, and whether tree or plant choice would help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Does NParks have plans to manage such wild bird populations in our estates?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: How would NParks tackle big populations of certain birds which appear seasonally?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would the choice of particular trees or plants help to resolve the problems of certain wild birds in our HDB estates?

sections.label: Transfer of four Acts
sections.summary: The Bill transfers administration of four Acts from AVA to NParks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The administration of each of these four Acts will be transferred under the Bill from AVA to NParks.

sections.label: AVA staff transfers
sections.summary: All AVA staff in food-related and non-food undertakings, including secondees, transfer to SFA and NParks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: All AVA staff in its present food-related and non-food undertakings, including secondees, will be transferred to SFA and NParks respectively.

sections.label: NParks public health partnerships
sections.summary: NParks joins MOH, NEA and SFA on public health, reviews animal-business regulation, and takes a science-based animal management approach.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: To address Prof Fatimah Lateef’s question on how NParks will partner other agencies to safeguard public health, NParks will join MOH and NEA, as well as SFA, which currently work closely together, to address public health issues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This is made an express new function of NParks in clause 3(a) of the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: NParks will also undertake a holistic review of the regulatory approach for animal-related businesses, such as pet boarders, pet breeders and veterinary centres.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Third, we will continue to take a holistic science-based approach to animal management This entails understanding the underlying drivers, putting in place appropriate public education programmes, and applying the appropriate animal-management measures for each specific case.

sections.label: Review of animal management measures
sections.summary: NParks will comprehensively review animal management measures, including the appropriate budget required.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Thereafter, NParks will undertake a comprehensive review of our animal management measures, including the appropriate budget required.

sections.label: Penalties for animal owners
sections.summary: Recalcitrant owners refusing HDB inspection may be fined up to $4,000; those convicted of inadequate pet care face fines or imprisonment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Under the Housing and Development (Animals) Rules, recalcitrant owners who refuse to allow HDB officers to enter and inspect their premises may be brought to Court where they can be fined up to $4,000 upon conviction.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The owners, if convicted in Court for failing to provide adequate care for their pets, may be liable to a fine not exceeding $10,000, or imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months, or both.

sections.label: Consideration of NParks enforcement powers
sections.summary: Powers for NParks officers need careful consideration as intrusive, while NParks engages stakeholders on animal health and welfare.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, we would need to consider very carefully whether to put in place such powers for NParks officers, as the powers are very intrusive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: NParks will continue to engage and work with stakeholders on holistic and science-based strategies to enhance animal health and welfare, as well as ensure that we co-exist harmoniously with wildlife and other animals.
